Beautiful bells and arpeggios. Suitable for rpg, exploration or puzzle game. Easy for perfect loop. I have precompressed this to be optimal for web distribution with VBR, I assure you the quality is 100% and better than 128kbps even if it looks like the sample rate is 32kHz and bitrate are lower. tracks.originalDescription: A light theme with 16-bit RPGs in mind, weaving gentle but firm mid and high tones. Suggested uses include stuff like a crystal dungeon, waterfall scene, peaceful village, gazing at a starry night, or relaxing to. RECOMMENDED: Version 1.2 is the newest revision and the most "complete". If you'd prefer it without flute, grab version 1.1. If you're specifically aiming for a thinner sound without flute or vibraphone, the original "Crystal Dungeon" is for you. Attribution Instructions: Please credit me as FoxSynergy. Use this freely, of course! If you let me know what you're working on I'd get a big kick out of it and also link to and promote your project if you like.
